rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Miniature.
Registration name: Bharani
rows.Origin:
Bred by K.S. Gopalaswamiengar (India, before 1973).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Gandy's Roses Ltd. in 1973 as 'Bharani'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend, white center. Amethyst blue. Mild fragrance. Small, semi-double to double, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Upright. Small, matte, light green foliage.

colour: Mauve or purple blend, white center. Amethyst blue.
